required_inputs: P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST: frozen public PWR/SB-LOCA manifest with labels, trajectory IDs, counts, units, sampling rate, and horizon.
P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT: trajectory- and scenario-level split manifest with zero cross-partition identifier overlap.
P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN: labels identifying PWR SB-LOCA transients, break-extent target definition and unit, sampling rate, and horizon.
P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS: unit-labelled physics-derived residual or conservation feature columns required by the candidate.

Dataset and label provenance, entity/scenario/time identities, preprocessing specifications, feature and target definitions, code and environment identities, calibration requirements, and intended-use conditions.
Declared in-distribution and out-of-distribution boundaries across entities, scenarios, sites, time periods, sensors, and fidelities.
incompatible_conditions: Invalid or unavailable data or label provenance, target definitions, units, sampling metadata, or required manifest.
Non-independent partitions, unresolved trajectory, scenario, entity, or temporal leakage, or preprocessing leakage.
Missing required physics-derived residual or conservation feature columns or unit labels.
Unresolved required inputs, unavailable calibration definition, unsupported deployment conditions, or unsupported target distribution.
Unavailable qualified specialist safety or domain review for consequential use.

assumptions: The observational unit is a labeled PWR/SB-LOCA trajectory or held-out trajectory-level record; the target population is public simulated PWR SB-LOCA transients and the sampling and label process are documented.
Missingness, measurement noise, dependence among windows within a trajectory, stationarity, exchangeability, and target prevalence are characterized rather than assumed away.
Trajectory-, scenario-, and time-aware partitions prevent correlated descendants and future information from crossing boundaries.
Physics-derived residual or conservation features are unit-labelled and treated as fixed inputs; their relationship to the learned temporal component is approximate unless independently verified.
Predictive intervals are interpreted under the declared calibration procedure and are not operational safety guarantees.
Generalization, uncertainty quality, and transfer remain unproven until a target-domain decisive test supports them.
baselines: Use the selected direction's matched temporal regression on the identical frozen split and resource ceiling as the primary baseline.
Add a simple persistence or classical statistical break-extent comparator only where the target and sampling semantics make it defined, under the same partition and resource rules.
Do not treat literature component results as baseline performance for this candidate.
controls: Compare baseline and candidate on identical entity-, scenario-, and time-aware partitions, preprocessing provenance, evaluation units, and resource accounting.
Remove physics-derived residual or conservation features while holding the temporal learner, preprocessing, split, and resource ceiling fixed.
Use a shuffled-label control to expose leakage or shortcut behavior and preserve its negative result.
Keep the calibration procedure, target unit, and evaluation population identical between baseline and candidate.
procedure_outline: Read only the manifest, labels, sampling, horizon, feature schema, and partition identities; keep fitting blocked on unresolved preconditions.
Define the entity, scenario, time, target, preprocessing, calibration, and provenance boundaries before any separately authorized comparison.
After all preconditions pass and separate authorization is granted, compare one bounded candidate with the matched baseline within the inherited ceilings.
Score each selected metric once and apply the copied stop and pivot criteria; record no deployment or safety conclusion.

primary_metrics.metric: Relative held-out break-extent MAE reduction versus baseline

uncertainty_handling: Separate sampling, label, measurement, model, parameter, optimization, and distribution-shift uncertainty; report intervals or repeat distributions at the trajectory or scenario level with an explicit aggregation rule.
Do not treat correlated windows, descendants, or augmented rows as independent replicates.
Audit M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE for held-out calibration and preserve unfavorable or unstable repeats and slices.
Keep generalization, uncertainty quality, and transfer unproven until a target-domain decisive test supports them.
validation_checks: P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST: verify a frozen public manifest with labels, trajectory IDs, counts, units, sampling rate, and horizon; count eligible labeled trajectories before fitting.
P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT: compare trajectory and scenario identifiers across partitions; fitting remains blocked unless overlap is zero.
P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN: verify every retained record is a labeled PWR SB-LOCA transient with declared break-extent unit, sampling rate, and horizon.
P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS: verify the physics-derived residual or conservation feature columns required by the candidate are present and unit-labelled.

Before interpreting M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE, M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE, or M-NEML-F01-D1-N, verify that no label, future, test, entity-linked, or preprocessing information crosses the training boundary and compare all methods under identical budgets.
failure_modes: Trajectory-, scenario-, entity-, or temporal leakage can inflate M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE or M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE and invalidate the evidence chain.
Preprocessing leakage or label contamination can make the predictive and calibration metrics non-decisive.
Missing or unit-inconsistent physics features can invalidate the hybrid claim and fail P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS.
Dataset, prevalence, or distribution shift can degrade M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE or M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE; preserve unsupported slices and do not relabel transfer as success.
Miscalibration, overconfident intervals, unstable optimization, and failed hybrid constraints can change M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE or M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE.
Insufficient eligible held-out trajectories change the M-NEML-F01-D1-N disposition; do not widen scope or claim data sufficiency.
safety_boundaries: Require qualified data, ML, domain, security, privacy, and safety review before operational control, protection, maintenance deferral, personnel decisions, or other consequential use.
Preserve deterministic protections, interlocks, conservative rules, and human authority; the learned component must not silently replace them.
Method coaching performs no data acquisition or upload, training, inference, model download, compute allocation, deployment, service startup, or operational decision.

Use public simulated data only within the research scope; generalization, uncertainty quality, and transfer remain unproven until target-domain decisive testing and never constitute operational safety validation.

does_not_support: A community-standard SB-LOCA split, early-warning horizon, OOD protocol, or safety validation.
limitations: Full-text dataset evidence still requires a frozen manifest, label and unit verification, horizon verification, and leakage preflight before the selected data claim can be tested.

limitations: Abstract-level method and transfer evidence does not verify the selected combined candidate, SB-LOCA-specific outcome, calibration, or resource use.

does_not_support: SB-LOCA-specific calibration, explicit physical residuals, or the exact compute budget.
